before.zh: 臣今與學官等詳議訖，謹具分析如後：獻祖宣皇帝、宣莊皇后、懿祖光皇帝、光懿皇后、文德皇后、高宗天皇大帝、則天皇后、中宗大聖大昭孝皇帝、和思皇后、昭成皇后、孝敬皇帝、地敬哀皇后已前十二座，親盡迭毀，宜遷諸太廟，祔於興聖廟。
before.en: We have deliberated with academicians and submit analysis: the twelve tablets before—Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Empress Xuanzhuang, Yizu Emperor Guang, Empress Guangyi, Empress Wende, Emperor Gaozong the Heavenly Sovereign Great, Empress Wu Zetian, Emperor Zhongzong the Great Sage Great Filial, Empress Hespi, Empress Zhaocheng, Emperor Xiaojing, Empress Di'ai—whose kin is exhausted and rotation destroyed, should move to line shrines and affix at Xingsheng Shrine.
before.literal: We have deliberated with academicians and submit analysis: the twelve tablets before—Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Empress Xuanzhuang, Yizu Emperor Guang, Empress Guangyi, Empress Wende, Emperor Gaozong the Heavenly Sovereign Great, Empress Wu Zetian, Emperor Zhongzong the Great Sage Great Filial, Empress Hespi, Empress Zhaocheng, Emperor Xiaojing, Empress Di'ai—whose kin is exhausted and rotation destroyed, should move to line shrines and affix at Xingsheng Shrine.

after.zh: 臣今與學官等詳議訖，謹具分析如後：獻祖宣皇帝、宣莊皇后、懿祖光皇帝、光懿皇后、文德皇后、高宗天皇大帝、則天皇后、中宗大聖大昭孝皇帝、和思皇后、昭成皇后、孝敬皇帝、地敬哀皇后已前十二座，親盡迭毀，宜遷諸太廟，祔於興聖廟。
after.en: We have deliberated with academicians and submit analysis: the twelve tablets before—Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Empress Xuanzhuang, Yizu Emperor Guang, Empress Guangyi, Empress Wende, Emperor Gaozong the Heavenly Sovereign Great, Empress Wu Zetian, Emperor Zhongzong the Great Sage Great Radiant Filial, Empress Hesi, Empress Zhaocheng, Emperor Xiaojing, Empress (Xiaojing) Ai—whose kin is exhausted and rotation destroyed, should move to line shrines and affix at Xingsheng Shrine.
after.literal: We have deliberated with academicians and submit analysis: the twelve tablets before—Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Empress Xuanzhuang, Yizu Emperor Guang, Empress Guangyi, Empress Wende, Emperor Gaozong the Heavenly Sovereign Great, Empress Wu Zetian, Emperor Zhongzong the Great Sage Great Radiant Filial, Empress Hesi, Empress Zhaocheng, Emperor Xiaojing, Empress (Xiaojing) Ai—whose kin is exhausted and rotation destroyed, should move to line shrines and affix at Xingsheng Shrine.

before.zh: 況周武受命，始都于豐，成王相宅，又卜於洛，烝祭歲於新邑，冊周公於太室。
before.en: Zhou Wu received the mandate, first seat at Feng; Cheng Wang chose dwelling, divined at Luo—sacrificed the year's harvest in the new settlement, enfeoffed Duke Zhou in the Grand Chamber.
before.literal: Zhou Wu received the mandate, first seat at Feng; Cheng Wang chose dwelling, divined again at Luo—sacrificed the year's harvest in the new settlement, enfeoffed Duke Zhou in the Grand Chamber.

after.zh: 況周武受命，始都于豐，成王相宅，又卜於洛，烝祭歲於新邑，冊周公於太室。

before.zh: 豈有九室合饗之主，而有置而不饗之文？

after.en: How can there be tablets for nine chambers of joint feasting, yet a text for installing them without feasting?

before.zh: 建武二年，於洛陽立廟，而成、哀、平三帝祭於西京。
before.en: Jianwu 2 built a Luoyang temple; Cheng, Ai, and Ping were sacrificed to in the west.
before.literal: In Jianwu year 2 a temple was built at Luoyang, while Cheng, Ai, and Ping were sacrificed to in the Western Capital.

after.zh: 建武二年，於洛陽立廟，而成、哀、平三帝祭於西京。
after.en: Jianwu 2 built a Luoyang temple; the three emperors Cheng, Ai, and Ping were sacrificed to in the Western Capital.
after.literal: In Jianwu year 2 a temple was built at Luoyang, while Cheng, Ai, and Ping were sacrificed to in the Western Capital.

before.zh: 按魯莊公二十八年冬，築郿，《左傳》為築發凡例，《谷梁》譏因藪澤之利，《公羊》稱避凶年造邑之嫌。
before.en: Lu, Zhuang 28 winter: Zuo generalizes on building; Guliang criticized marsh profit; Gongyang cited famine-year suspicion.
before.literal: According to Lu, Duke Zhuang year 28 winter, building Fu—the Zuo Commentary made a general rule for building; Guliang criticized profiting from marsh and lake; Gongyang spoke of avoiding the suspicion of building a town in a famine year.

after.zh: 按魯莊公二十八年冬，築郿，《左傳》為築發凡例，《谷梁》譏因藪澤之利，《公羊》稱避凶年造邑之嫌。
after.en: In the winter of Duke Zhuang of Lu's 28th year Lu built Fu (Mei); Zuo generalizes on building; Guliang criticized marsh profit; Gongyang cited famine-year suspicion.
after.literal: According to Lu, Duke Zhuang year 28 winter, building Fu—the Zuo Commentary made a general rule for building; Guliang criticized profiting from marsh and lake; Gongyang spoke of avoiding the suspicion of building a town in a famine year.

before.zh: 當春秋二百年間，魯凡城二十四邑，唯郿一邑稱築，其二十三邑，豈皆有宗廟先君之主乎；
before.en: In 240 years Lu walled twenty-four places; only Fu is "built"—did the other twenty-three all have ancestral tablets?
before.literal: In the two hundred years of Spring and Autumn, Lu walled twenty-four settlements in all; only Fu was called "built"—did the other twenty-three all have ancestral tablets of former lords?

before.en: The Record also says: "Sacrifice out of season is ritual."

before.zh: 時秘書監顏師古議曰：「臣傍觀祭典，遍考禮經，宗廟皆在京師，不於下土別置。
before.en: Then Secretariat Director Yan Shigu argued: "I have surveyed sacrificial canons and examined ritual classics—ancestral temples are all in the capital, not separately set in the provinces.

before.zh: 《記》曰：「天無二日，土無二王，嘗、禘、郊、社，尊無二上。」
before.en: The Record: "Heaven has no second sun; earth no second king; xiang, di, suburban, and soil—honor has no second supreme."
before.literal: The Record: "Heaven has no second sun; earth no second king; xiang, di, suburban, and soil—honor has no second supreme."

before.zh: 貞觀十六年，將行禘祭，有司請集禮官學士等議，太常卿韋挺等一十八人議曰：「古之王者，富有四海，而不朝夕上膳於宗廟者，患其禮過也。
before.en: Zhenguan 16, before di sacrifice, offices requested ritualists and scholars to debate; Director Wei Ting and seventeen others argued: "Ancient kings possessing the four seas did not daily present food at the temple—fearing excessive ritual.

after.en: Zhenguan 16, before di sacrifice, offices requested ritualists and scholars to debate; Wei Ting, Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others, eighteen in all, argued: "Ancient kings possessing the four seas did not daily present food at the temple—fearing excessive ritual.
after.literal: Zhenguan 16, before di sacrifice, offices requested ritualists and scholars to debate; Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Ting and others, eighteen persons, argued: "Ancient kings possessing the four seas did not daily present food at the temple—fearing excessive ritual.

before.zh: '至於臣有大功享祿，其後孝子率禮，潔粢豐盛，禮、祀、烝、嘗，四時不輟，國家大祫，又得配焉。
before.en: When a minister has great merit and enjoys emolument, later filial sons observe ritual with pure offerings in abundance—li, si, zheng, and xiang without cease through the four seasons; at the great xia he may also share.

before.zh: 又漢、魏祫祀，皆在十月，晉朝禮官，欲用孟秋殷祭，左僕射孔安國啟彈，坐免者不一。
before.en: Again, Han and Wei xia sacrifices were all held in the tenth month. Jin ritual officers wished to use the mid-autumn yin sacrifice; Left Vice Director Kong Anguo memorialized impeachment, and more than one was dismissed from office.

after.en: Again, Han and Wei xia sacrifices were all held in the tenth month. Jin ritual officers wished to use the yin sacrifice in the first month of autumn; Left Vice Director Kong Anguo memorialized impeachment, and more than one was dismissed from office.

before.zh: 蓋以禘後置祫，二周有半，舉以全數，謂之三年，譬如三年一閏，只用三十二月也。
before.en: After di, xia follows two and a half cycles; rounded to a full number that is "three years," as one intercalation uses thirty-six months.
before.literal: It is that after di, xia is placed two and a half cycles later; taking the full number, it is called three years—like one intercalation in three years using only thirty-six months.

after.zh: 蓋以禘後置祫，二周有半，舉以全數，謂之三年，譬如三年一閏，只用三十二月也。
after.en: After di, xia follows two and a half cycles; rounded to a full number that is "three years," as one intercalation uses thirty-two months.
after.literal: It is that after di, xia is placed two and a half cycles later; taking the full number, it is called three years—like one intercalation in three years using only thirty-two months.

before.zh: 祫後去禘，十有八月而近，禘後去祫，三十二月而遙，分析不均，粗於算矣。
before.en: Xia to di is 18 months (too near); di to xia is 36 (too far)—uneven spacing.
before.literal: From xia to di is eighteen months—near; from di to xia thirty-six months—far; the analysis is uneven and crude in calculation.

after.zh: 祫後去禘，十有八月而近，禘後去祫，三十二月而遙，分析不均，粗於算矣。
after.en: Xia to di is 18 months (too near); di to xia is 32 (too far)—uneven spacing.
after.literal: From xia to di is eighteen months—near; from di to xia thirty-two months—far; the analysis is uneven and crude in calculation.

before.zh: 禮部員外郎崔宗之駁下太常，令更詳議，令集賢學士陸善經等更加詳核，善經亦以其議為允。
before.en: Cui Zongzhi of the Ministry of Rites objected and sent the case back to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Lu Shanqing and other academicians reviewed it and approved.
before.literal: Supernumerary Secretary in the Ministry of Rites Cui Zongzhi rebutted and sent the matter down to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices for further deliberation; Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies Lu Shanqing and others were ordered to examine further, and Shanqing also approved this deliberation.

before.zh: 於是太常卿韋縚奏曰：「禮有禘祫，俱稱殷祭，二法更用，鱗次相承。
before.en: Thereupon Director Wei Zong memorialized: "The rites provide di and xia, both called yin sacrifices; the two methods alternate in scale-like succession.

before.zh: 頃在四月，已行禘享，今指孟冬，又申祫儀，合食禮頻，恐違先典。
before.en: Recently in the fourth month, di was already performed; now pointing to mid-winter, xia rites are again proposed—combined feasting too frequent, fearing violation of former canons.

before.en: On the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month of the seventh Zhenyuan year, Director Pei Yu memorialized: "The rites of di and xia—in Yin and Zhou, because moved temples all came after the Grand Ancestor, combined feasting could be ordered and honor and baseness not err.

before.zh: 今二祖已祧，九室惟序，則太祖之位又安可不正？
before.en: Now the two ancestors have been tithed; the nine chambers are in order only—how can the Grand Ancestor's position again not be corrected?
before.literal: Now the two ancestors have been tithed; the nine chambers are in order only—how can the Grand Ancestor's position again not be corrected?

after.zh: 今二祖已祧，九室惟序，則太祖之位又安可不正？
after.en: Now the two ancestors have been removed to the remote-ancestor chamber; the nine chambers are in order only—how can the Grand Ancestor's position again not be corrected?
after.literal: Now the two ancestors have been tithed; the nine chambers are in order only—how can the Grand Ancestor's position again not be corrected?

before.zh: 謹按漢永光四年詔，議罷郡國廟及親盡之祖，丞相韋玄成議太上、孝惠廟，皆親盡宜毀，太上廟主宜瘞於園，孝惠主遷于太祖廟。
before.en: Han Yongguang 4: Wei Xuancheng urged destroying kin-exhausted shrines; the Supreme tablet was buried in the park and Filial Emperor's moved to the Grand Ancestor temple.
before.literal: Respectfully according to Han Yongguang 4 edict, deliberating abolition of commandery and state temples and ancestors of exhausted kin—Chancellor Wei Xuancheng deliberated the Supreme and Filial Emperor temples, all kin exhausted and fit to destroy; the Supreme temple tablet should be buried in the park, the Filial Emperor tablet moved to the Grand Ancestor temple.

after.zh: 謹按漢永光四年詔，議罷郡國廟及親盡之祖，丞相韋玄成議太上、孝惠廟，皆親盡宜毀，太上廟主宜瘞於園，孝惠主遷于太祖廟。
after.en: The Han Yongguang 4 edict called for abolishing the commandery and kingdom temples and kin-exhausted ancestors; Chancellor Wei Xuancheng proposed that the temples of the Supreme Emperor and Emperor Hui, being kin-exhausted, be destroyed; the Supreme tablet was buried in the park and Filial Emperor's moved to the Grand Ancestor temple.
after.literal: Respectfully according to Han Yongguang 4 edict, deliberating abolition of commandery and state temples and ancestors of exhausted kin—Chancellor Wei Xuancheng deliberated the Supreme and Filial Emperor temples, all kin exhausted and fit to destroy; the Supreme temple tablet should be buried in the park, the Filial Emperor tablet moved to the Grand Ancestor temple.

before.zh: 國朝始饗四廟，宣、光並太祖、世祖神主祔於廟。
before.en: Tang first had four temples; Xuan and Guang were enshrined with Grand Ancestor and Shizu.
before.literal: Our dynasty at first feasted at four temples; Xuan and Guang together with the Grand Ancestor and Shizu tablets were enshrined in the temple.

after.zh: 國朝始饗四廟，宣、光並太祖、世祖神主祔於廟。
after.en: Our dynasty first offered sacrifice at four temples; the tablets of Xuan and Guang together with the Grand Ancestor and Shizu were enshrined in the temple.
after.literal: Our dynasty at first feasted at four temples; Xuan and Guang together with the Grand Ancestor and Shizu tablets were enshrined in the temple.

before.en: Weming 1, enshrining Gaozong, moved Emperor Xuan to the western side chamber.
before.literal: In the first Weming year, when Gaozong was enshrined, Emperor Xuan was first moved to the western side chamber.

before.en: Assistant Magistrate of Tongguan Zhong Ziling submitted: "Now Confucians cite the words 'though the son is equal in sageliness, he does not precede the father in eating,' wishing to have the already distant Offering Ancestor temporarily sit east-facing, matching Heaven with the Grand Ancestor while the Grand Ancestor humbly takes zhao and mu—this is extremely unprincipled.

before.en: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Huichang, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Institute memorialized: "In di and he sacrifices prayer texts the titles of Emperor Muzong, Empress Dowager Wei of Xuande, Emperor Jingzong, Emperor Wenzong, and Emperor Wuzong—because of prior ordering by kin closeness, the Muzong chamber was called 'elder brother,' not fitting ritual text.

before.zh: 舊儀，高祖之廟，則開府儀同三司淮安王神通、禮部尚書河間王孝恭、陝東道大行台右僕射鄖國公殷開山、吏部尚書渝國公劉政會配饗。
before.en: Old ceremony: in Gaozu's temple, Acting Honorable General of the Palace Gate with Equal Third Rank Prince Huai'an of the Huai state Wang Tong, Minister of Rites Prince Hejian of the He state Wang Xiaogong, Grand Marshal of the Shandong Circuit with Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Duke of E of E state Yin Kaishan, and Minister of Personnel Duke of Yu of Yu state Liu Zhenghui were associated in feasting.

before.en: In Zhongzong's temple, Attendant Prince Jinghui of Pingyang commandery, Attendant Prince Fuyang of Fuyang commandery Huan Yanfan, and Director of the Secretariat Prince Nanyang of Nanyang commandery Yuan Shuji were associated in feasting.

before.en: In Ruizong's temple, Grand Tutor Duke of Xu of Xu state Su Gui and Left Chancellor Duke of Xu of Xu state Liu Youqiu were associated in feasting.

before.zh: 天寶六載正月，詔：京城章懷、節湣、惠莊、惠文、惠宣太子，與隱太子、懿德太子同為一廟，呼為七太子廟，以便於祀享。
before.en: In the first month of the sixth year of Tianbao, an edict: Crown Princes Zhanghuai, Jiemin, Huizhuang, Huiwen, and Huixuan in the capital, together with the Hidden Crown Prince and the Virtuous Consort Crown Prince, form one temple, called the Seven Crown Princes' Temple, for convenience in sacrifice.
before.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Tianbao, an edict: Crown Princes Zhanghuai, Jiemin, Huizhuang, Huiwen, and Huixuan in the capital, together with the Hidden Crown Prince and the Virtuous Consort Crown Prince, are joined as one temple, called the Seven Crown Princes' Temple, for convenience in sacrifice.

before.zh: 太廟配饗功臣，高祖室加裴寂、劉文靜，太宗室加長孫無忌、李靖、杜如晦，高宗室加褚遂良、高季輔、劉仁軌，中宗室加狄仁傑、魏元忠、王同皎等十一人。
before.en: Meritorious ministers associated in feasting at the Grand Temple: to Gaozu's chamber added Pei Ji and Liu Wenjing; to Taizong's chamber added Zhangsun Wuji, Li Jing, and Du Ruhui; to Gaozong's chamber added Chu Suiliang, Gao Jifu, and Liu Rengui; to Zhongzong's chamber added Di Renjie, Wei Yuanzhong, Wang Tongjiao, and eleven others.
